{ "rules": [
    "Model forecasts are consistently too low by 0.2-0.5 for the first 10-15 days, showing significant lag behind price momentum",
    "Sentiment turning positive ( >0.33) correlates with faster price rebounds than model predicts, especially in the first 2 weeks of the forecast horizon",
    "Model underestimates price peaks by 0.3-0.7 when sentiment has been consistently positive over the previous 5-7 days",
    "Mean reversion effect is stronger than model assumes, with prices converging toward historical means faster than forecast trajectory suggests",
    "When sentiment turns negative (-0.33), true outcomes decline more sharply than model predicts, with a lag of 2-3 evaluation days",
    "Model overshoots current prices when sentiment is low but historical ranges suggest more conservative movement",
    "The gap between model forecasts and true outcomes widens from ~0.2-0.3 initially to ~0.5-0.7 by day 15-20 in the forecast horizon"
] }
